result.reviewScopeSummary: Story 0 is an infrastructure story with no standalone end-user ACs, so the review focused on the Definition of Done and declared non-TC coverage: shared source-management contracts, Convex schema/index seams, provenance vocabulary, reusable fixtures, supporting contract tests, and the configured story/epic gates.

verified: S0-DOD-1 Shared contracts now define repository identity, source attachment summaries, provenance entries, refresh/detach responses, route params/path constants, and source-management error codes.
S0-DOD-2 Convex schema/index seams now cover repositoryFullName-based duplicate keys, four-state hydration, refresh metadata, and soft-detach durability.
S0-DOD-3 Provenance durability now copies immutable repository identity separately from current attachment enrichment state.
S0-DOD-4 Reusable fixtures now cover four-state freshness, pending refresh, soft detach, process shadowing, missing-target-ref duplicate handling, unavailable sources, and degraded provenance.
S0-NTC-1 Automated contract tests verify the expanded source schemas and reject missing Epic 6 identity/freshness fields.

additionalObservations: AGENTS.md references docs/onboarding/current-state-* files, but those onboarding docs are not present in this checkout; verification relied on the story, tech design, test plan, and inspected code/tests.

The repo's verify-all script passed end-to-end; its final e2e phase currently reports a scaffold skip message rather than running a real suite, and that is the present script behavior rather than a Story 0 regression.
